v.t: Judge not, that ye be not judged.

v.t: Or how wilt thou say to thy brother, Let me pull out the mote out of thine eye; and, behold, a beam is in thine own eye?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Thou hypocrite, first cast out the beam out of thine own eye; and then shalt thou see clearly to cast out the mote out of thy brother’s eye.

v.t: Give not that which is holy unto the dogs, neither cast ye your pearls before swine, lest they trample them under their feet, and turn again and rend you.

v.t: Or what man is there of you, whom if his son ask bread, will he give him a stone?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.

v.t: Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:

tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Prov 16:25 (107 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Beware of false prophets, which come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly they are ravening wolves.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Ye shall know them by their fruits. Do men gather grapes of thorns, or figs of thistles?

v.t: Even so every good tree bringeth forth good fruit; but a corrupt tree bringeth forth evil fruit.

v.t: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.

v.t: Every tree that bringeth not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Wherefore by their fruits ye shall know them.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father which is in heaven.

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works?

tm.jesus: Marked as words of Jesus in the KJV source text.

v.t: And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity.

v.t: Therefore whosoever heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them, I will liken him unto a wise man, which built his house upon a rock:

v.t: And the rain descended, and the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat upon that house; and it fell not: for it was founded upon a rock.

v.t: And every one that heareth these sayings of mine, and doeth them not, shall be likened unto a foolish man, which built his house upon the sand:

v.t: And it came to pass, when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine:
